headline: Fusion Finance Q2 Profit Rebounds as Margins Expand
summary: Fusion Finance reported a profit rebound and a 167 basis point margin expansion in the second quarter of fiscal 2027.
why: Fusion Finance operates in the microfinance and lending sector, where margin movements indicate credit portfolio health.

impacts.name: Fusion Finance
impacts.why: Higher net margins and rebounding profits directly improve the fundamental outlook for lenders.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Significant margin expansion and a bottom-line recovery drive positive investor sentiment.
